nodes.summary: Let $\chi_4$ be the nontrivial Dirichlet character modulo $4$, so $\chi_4(n) = 1$ for $n \equiv 1 \pmod 4$ and $\chi_4(n) = -1$ for $n \equiv 3 \pmod 4$. Let $D$ be an integer with $D \equiv 3 \pmod 4$ and let $p$ be an odd natural number. Then $\chi_4(p) \cdot \left(\frac{p}{|D|}\right) = \left(\frac{D}{p}\right)$, where $\left(\frac{p}{|D|}\right)$ is the Jacobi symbol and $\left(\frac{D}{p}\right)$ is the…
nodes.title: Kronecker symbol at odd numbers for integers congruent to 3 mod 4

nodes.summary: An integer $D$ is a fundamental discriminant if either $D$ is squarefree and $D \equiv 1 \pmod 4$, or $D = 4m$ for some squarefree integer $m$ with $m \equiv 2 \pmod 4$ or $m \equiv 3 \pmod 4$.
nodes.title: Fundamental discriminant

nodes.summary: For every integer $m$ and every odd natural number $p$, the Jacobi symbol $\left(\frac{4m}{p}\right)$ equals $\left(\frac{m}{p}\right)$.
nodes.title: Jacobi symbol of $4m$ at an odd denominator

nodes.summary: Let $D$ be a negative integer with $D \equiv 1 \pmod 4$ and let $p$ be an odd prime. Then the Jacobi symbol $\left(\frac{p}{|D|}\right)$ equals the Kronecker symbol $\left(\frac{D}{p}\right)$.
nodes.title: Kronecker symbol at odd primes for negative integers congruent to 1 mod 4

nodes.summary: Let $D$ be an integer with $D \equiv 1 \pmod 4$ and let $p$ be an odd prime. Then the Jacobi symbol $\left(\frac{p}{|D|}\right)$ equals the Kronecker symbol $\left(\frac{D}{p}\right)$.
nodes.title: Kronecker symbol at odd primes for integers congruent to 1 mod 4

nodes.summary: Let $D$ be a positive integer with $D \equiv 1 \pmod 4$ and let $p$ be an odd prime. Then the Jacobi symbol $\left(\frac{p}{|D|}\right)$ equals the Kronecker symbol $\left(\frac{D}{p}\right)$.
nodes.title: Quadratic reciprocity for the Kronecker symbol, positive $D \equiv 1 \pmod 4$

nodes.summary: For every integer $m$ and every odd natural number $p$, the Jacobi symbol $\left(\frac{2m}{p}\right)$ equals $\chi_8(p) \left(\frac{m}{p}\right)$, where $\chi_8$ is the Dirichlet character modulo $8$ with $\chi_8(n) = 1$ for $n \equiv \pm 1 \pmod 8$, $\chi_8(n) = -1$ for $n \equiv \pm 3 \pmod 8$, and $\chi_8(n) = 0$ for even $n$.
nodes.title: Jacobi symbol of $2m$ at an odd denominator

nodes.summary: For an integer $D$ and a natural number $p$, the Kronecker symbol of $D$ at $p$ is the Kronecker symbol of $D$ at two if $p = 2$, the Legendre symbol $\left(\frac{D}{p}\right)$ if $p$ is an odd prime, and $0$ if $p$ is not prime.
nodes.title: Kronecker symbol at a prime

nodes.summary: For an integer $D$, the Kronecker symbol of $D$ at $2$ is $0$ if $D$ is even, $1$ if $D \equiv \pm 1 \pmod 8$, and $-1$ if $D \equiv \pm 3 \pmod 8$.
nodes.title: Kronecker symbol at two

nodes.summary: Even `m % 4 = 3` subcase for odd `p`: reduce `4 * m` to `m`, identify `kroneckerSym` with `jacobiSym` at odd denominators, then apply the `D % 4 = 3` bridge to `m` itself. Covers prime and composite odd denominators alike.
nodes.title: Kronecker–Jacobi bridge for 4m with m ≡ 3 mod 4

nodes.summary: For every integer $D$ and every prime $p \ne 2$, the Kronecker symbol $\left(\frac{D}{p}\right)$ equals the Jacobi symbol $\left(\frac{D}{p}\right)$.
nodes.title: Kronecker and Jacobi symbols agree at odd primes

nodes.summary: For every integer $D$ and every prime $p$, the Kronecker symbol $\left(\frac{D}{p}\right)$ equals the Kronecker symbol of $D$ at the prime $p$.
nodes.title: Kronecker symbol with a prime denominator

nodes.summary: For an integer $D$ and a natural number $n$, the Kronecker symbol $\left(\frac{D}{n}\right)$ is defined as follows. If $n = 0$, it is $1$ when $D = \pm 1$ and $0$ otherwise. If $n \ge 1$ and $n = p_1 p_2 \cdots p_k$ is the factorization of $n$ into primes, listed with multiplicity, it is the product of the Kronecker symbols of $D$ at the primes $p_1, \ldots, p_k$ (the empty product $1$ when $n = 1$).
nodes.title: Kronecker symbol

nodes.summary: Let $D$ be a fundamental discriminant. Then there is a unique integer-valued Dirichlet character $\chi$ modulo $|D|$ such that $\chi(n \bmod |D|) = \left(\frac{D}{n}\right)$ for every natural number $n$, where $\left(\frac{D}{n}\right)$ is the Kronecker symbol.
nodes.title: Quadratic Dirichlet character of a fundamental discriminant

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
